title: •Jabba’s Space Cruiser
caption: •Jabba’s Space Cruiser (V)
game_text: May add 2 alien pilots and 6 passengers. May deploy an {independent} starship (with a pilot aboard, if unpiloted) here from hand and/or Reserve Deck (for free) as a ‘react;’ reshuffle. If Jabba here, immune to attrition.
lore: Flying fortress of Jabba Desilijic Tiure. Reaches speeds of 800 kph in atmosphere. The crime lord installed hidden gunports as an unpleasant surprise for would-be pirates.
copyright: © LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in heading and caption (Jabba’s). Banner CAPITAL: UBRIKKIAN LUXURY SPACE YACHT. Stats POWER 5 / ARMOR 5 / HYPERSPEED 4; slip deploy 4 / forfeit 6 (printed 5 / 5). Scomp-link ring → scomp true. Inline icon 'an [blue wheel] starship' → {independent} (stub 'Independent'). Curly single quotes ‘react;’ (semicolon inside). Icon column top to bottom: independent (blue wheel), nav (red square, green dome). Lore matches the scan (also checked on the 745 V10 remake). Base scan only at 350 px; copyright = Special Edition line (run default). Modern: V10-D-jabbasspacecruiser.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 10 remake); VB3 (350) also exists, not downloaded.
